verdict.rationale: Vercel documents a REST API with OpenAPI spec, SDK, access tokens, webhooks, and an official CLI, all verified live via probes (openapi.json, llms.txt, docs.md), giving AI-native users multiple documented, machine-readable ways to drive the product programmatically. missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration of API robustness/rate limits beyond Vercel's own docs.
